overview_description.description: The Company provides software to improve the Smash experience for streamers, players, tournament attendees, and spectators (collectively, “General Users”) and for registered users who are tournament organizers (“Tournament Organizers”). The Company provides a platform for enabling connections between General Users and Tournament Organizers and for the collection of payments with respect to the sale of tickets, registrations, merchandise, and services for, and the solicitation of donations with respect to, events registered on the Site from General Users.

about_short_description.short_description: Smash.gg provides software to improve the Smash experience for streamers, players, tournament attendees, and spectators.

product.name: Tournaments
product.description: Smash.gg organizes and hosts various gaming tournaments for different games, including Super Smash Bros., TEKKEN, Street Fighter, and more, both online and offline.

product.name: Circuits and Leagues
product.description: Smash.gg manages competitive circuits and leagues for games like Pokémon Unite, Rocket League, Brawlhalla, and Mortal Kombat, providing structured competitive play over extended periods.

product.name: Event Management
product.description: Smash.gg offers tools and services for organizing and managing gaming events, including registration, scheduling, and results reporting.

product.name: Online Competitions
product.description: Smash.gg facilitates online gaming competitions, allowing players to compete in various games from remote locations.

product.name: Community Building
product.description: Smash.gg provides a platform for building and engaging gaming communities through competitive events and social features.
